description: Site de villégiature exceptionnel situé dans la vallée du Lac Saint-Mathieu, au coeur du Bas-Saint-Laurent, à proximité de Trois-Pistoles, Rimouski, Rivière-du-Loup et Témiscouata-sur-le-Lac. Le Camping Bas-Saint-Laurent est situé à Saint-Mathieu-de-Rioux, en bordure du lac Saint-Mathieu, un plan d'eau navigable et non inondable, offrant un accès direct à une plage ainsi qu'à une marina privée. Anciennement exploité sous la bannière KOA Resort jusqu'en 2024, il figurait parmi les quinze plus beaux campings KOA en Amérique du Nord. L'établissement détient une classification cinq étoiles de Camping Québec, a été nommé « Camping de l'année » en 2016 et 2022 et bénéficie d'une cote parfaite de Good Sam. Le site compte 264 emplacements, dont 227 sites pour véhicules récréatifs desservis avec 5 services, 25 emplacements pour tentes et 12 unités de prêt-à-camper comprenant des cabines et des chalets quatre saisons. 45 % à 50 % des emplacements sont loués avec des saisonniers, la balance des sites est réservée pour les voyageurs, et ce au choix du propriétaire. Plus de 10 millions de dollars ont été investis dans le développement du site. Un potentiel de développement supplémentaire existe sur onze terrains résidentiels adjacents, non inclus dans le prix demandé. Une visite s'impose!

description_en:
An exceptional resort located in the Lac Saint-Mathieu Valley, in the heart of the Bas-Saint-Laurent region, near Trois-Pistoles, Rimouski, Rivière-du-Loup, and Témiscouata-sur-le-Lac. Open year-round with 12 luxury four-season cottages. Campground with high-quality facilities.  Formerly a 5-star Koa Resort. Features 262 campsites, a marina, a large amusement park, and several buildings. All utilities are underground, and the campground has a drinking water well and a modern wastewater treatment plant.  Provides access to hiking, snowmobiling, and ATV trails. Ideal for outdoor enthusiasts! 
							

							
							Camping Bas-Saint-Laurent is located in  Saint-Mathieu-de-Rioux, on the shores of Lake  Saint-Mathieu, a navigable, flood-free body of water  offering direct access to a beach and a private marina. 
Formerly operated under the KOA Resort banner until 2024,  it was ranked among the fifteen most beautiful KOA  campgrounds in North America. The campground holds a  five-star rating from Camping Québec, was named Campground  of the Year in 2016 and 2022, and boasts a perfect rating  from Good Sam. 
The site has 264 sites, including 227 fully serviced RV  sites with 5 courses, 25 tent sites, and 12 ready-to-camp  units comprising cabins and four-season cottages.  
45% to 50% of the sites are rented to seasonal guests; the  remaining sites are reserved for travelers, at the owner's  discretion. 
The campground is managed by a manager, who would like to  remain in her position if desired, several employees, and  an active shareholder.  
The cottages can be operated year-round with a two-month  break in the fall during the off-season. 
The facilities include a large reception building housing  an office, convenience store, dairy bar, restrooms, and  laundry room, as well as a year-round building featuring a  restaurant-bar with a liquor license, an authorized gas  station, living quarters, and a large terrace. A  multipurpose community hall, a fully equipped garage, and a  fleet of machinery round out the facilities.  
The site has a large electrical capacity, with two  600-volt, 600-amp power connections. 
Recreational amenities include a heated pool, a spa, water  play areas, a water slide, a wading pool, a mini-golf  course, a BMX track, a playground, and rentals for kayaks,  stand-up paddleboards, and go-karts. The marina can  accommodate approximately fifteen boats. 
Wastewater treatment is provided by a facility shared with  the MRC, which also maintains a contingency fund. 
Over $10 million has been invested in the site's  development. 
Additional development potential exists on eleven adjacent  residential lots, not included in the asking price. 
A visit is a must!
